bootstrap_probe_diagnostics.records: exactly one compact JSON line for parent, child, and grandchild; each binds pid and ppid
bootstrap_probe_diagnostics.cpu_fields: each line includes independent SELF segment and waited CHILDREN before/after/delta totals

source_binding.deferred_full_sha256: For the approved_compiled_binary branch only: after the locked shared reservation is admitted, one O_NOFOLLOW stable-FD pass is made at owned_launch and one after_owned_reap pass is made after the owned tree is confirmed reaped. Each pass requires a regular FD fstat before and after the single full SHA-256 read, lexical-path lstat metadata before and after, and matching device/inode/bytes/mtime_ns/ctime_ns; both observations are recorded. The binary is excluded from the generic deferred hash pass and is never opened or payload-hashed during preflight. Other deferred inputs retain the inherited v12 behavior; launch failures have no after pass.

m0.bootstrap: only cpu/tests with B01..B07 and bootstrap_probe.py, or sealed small JSON/CSV/XML/text light metadata

b07_notify_root.helper: one regular non-symlink root-reviewed file directly under the fixed LFD-01 control root, normal input with full SHA-256 binding
b07_notify_root.subtree: probe subprocess inherits the admitted worker cpuset, RLIMIT_AS, owned process group, and worker RUSAGE scope
b07_notify_root.queue: helper performs at most one fixed codex queue notification after verifying the original controller identity has exited
b07_notify_root.job_binding: request --job-id must equal the actual dispatcher job_id before worker launch; a legal but different LFD01_ id is rejected by both dispatch and worker validation

branch_fields.solver_branch: optional; absent means the unchanged official v12 solver branch; approved_compiled_binary selects only the v14 branch

cumulative_scopes.campaign: effective_caps, never reset by a new tranche
cumulative_scopes.pool: adopted work_pool or central_reserve, filtered by pool metadata
cumulative_scopes.tranche: immutable allocation, filtered by pool and tranche_id

reservation.actual_mem_available_guard: MemAvailable >= active RAM reservations + request RAM

process_accounting.cpu_source: RUSAGE self+children for reaped descendants plus live owned group utime+stime only while live

cpu_capacity.set: online CPUs from /sys/devices/system/cpu/online intersected with the current cgroup effective cpuset
cpu_capacity.cgroup_identity: /proc/self/cgroup is read and validated before resolving /sys/fs/cgroup/<relative>/cpuset.cpus.effective (v1 cpuset.cpus fallback); inherited ancestors are checked only up to that validated mount root
cpu_capacity.request_affinity: must be a subset of that online/effective set; execution still pins to the request cpuset

process_accounting.ownership: launch-persisted child/group pid, host, boot_id, start_ticks; Linux subreaper is enabled before every worker/target Popen; current PGID members require exact PID/start_ticks, the token-bound parent-proof handshake, or a bounded PPID chain to a previously verified member/subreaper identity with the same PGID and post-launch start time; unknown members block killpg and remain an explicit uncertainty

subreaper.worker_identity: host/boot/pid/start_ticks captured in the owned group before target launch
subreaper.adopted_member_proof: PPID chain reaches that worker only when PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER was true, member PGID equals the launch PGID, and member start_ticks is no earlier than the launch leader

parent_proof.contents: parent and surviving child host/boot/pid/start_ticks plus child PPID/PGID, written atomically before the direct parent exits
parent_proof.validation: random token, expected target identity, exact PGID, start ordering, and live PID/start/PGID recheck when available
parent_proof.invalid_or_missing: never signal an unverified PGID; retain the reservation and durable recovery waiting state

rlimit_fsize.worker_metadata: soft=current real parent ledger st_size plus AUTHORITY_MAX_BYTES (minimum 2*AUTHORITY_MAX_BYTES); hard=exactly 256 GiB after inherited-hard precheck
rlimit_fsize.scientific_child_output: request.estimated_storage_bytes (<=256 GiB) applied as child soft/hard by SHA-bound /usr/bin/prlimit after the request binary binding is checked
rlimit_fsize.light_output: request.estimated_storage_bytes capped at 256 MiB and applied as sealed light worker soft/hard
rlimit_fsize.inherited_hard_precheck: current RLIMIT_FSIZE hard must be RLIM_INFINITY or >= authorized_global_hard_bytes; otherwise fail closed without raising privileges
rlimit_fsize.light_hard_bytes: <=268435456 and never above the inherited hard limit

trusted_helpers.role: child RLIMIT_FSIZE wrapper; request command/binary binding remains unchanged

process_accounting.final_reap: after direct/group grace or kill, bounded waitpid reap targets only members with exact PID/start/PGID proof; every proven zombie must be reaped and the final identity-checked snapshot must complete before child_exit_confirmed, deferred/G2 proof, and v6 CPU cutoff

children_rusage_interval.before: raw resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN immediately before the admitted target child Popen
children_rusage_interval.after: raw resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN after real wait and final owned-tree reap, before deferred/posthash proof
children_rusage_interval.delta: after minus before for utime, stime, and total CPU

reliability.atomic_json: each call uses a unique same-directory temporary name and removes it after replace
reliability.worker_runtime_state: snapshot mutation, serialization, and atomic replacement stay inside the shared state lock; checkpoint CPU fields merge under the same lock
reliability.launch_cpu_sample: owned-child launch preserves the worker-entry last trusted CPU counter and immediately samples RUSAGE plus live verified group CPU without resetting it before the first heartbeat
reliability.orphan_recovery_import: all v6 imports insert the canonical SCRIPTS_ROOT before import_module
reliability.terminal_guarded_hook: v6._guarded_atomic_json is bound to the serializable LFD terminal projection for the duration of run_request and restored afterward; v6 normal fixed-point writer remains the final writer
reliability.launch_failure_cleanup: post-Popen identity or owned-child persistence failure synchronously cleans the verified group when identity exists, otherwise the exact Popen handle only; identity uncertainty is retained and no unverified PGID is signalled
reliability.watcher_shutdown: done is set, watchdog Timer is cancelled and joined, heartbeat/storage/RSS threads are joined without a timeout, and watchdog/RSS/storage callbacks recheck done before self/group signal
reliability.rss_state_merge: RSS terminal flags and cleanup are merged into live runtime_state under state_lock after a fresh snapshot; a stale detached snapshot is never written back
reliability.terminal_settlement_gate: when an owned child exists and child_exit_confirmed is false, the guarded terminal writer raises before v6 removes the reservation or appends a normal charge; guardian recovery settles only after verified group exit or a bounded unknown interval
reliability.guardian_recovery_persistence: after worker exit, retry recover at the bounded poll interval until confirmed settlement or the request hard deadline; write recovery_waiting_for_owned_exit while guardian remains alive and never label that state completed
reliability.recovery_group_source: recover may read the atomic worker-runtime record when owned-child-launch.json was not reached; an observed child with no durable group remains identity-unavailable and cannot release its reservation
reliability.proof_only_reap: worker and guardian recovery reap only exact identity-proven target-group members; waitpid(-1) is never used, and un-reaped zombies keep child_exit_confirmed false

infrastructure_accounting.controller: dispatch writes one immutable RUSAGE_SELF snapshot before returning
infrastructure_accounting.guardian: terminal guardian writes one immutable RUSAGE_SELF snapshot; RUSAGE_CHILDREN is excluded because it contains the worker
infrastructure_accounting.guardian_children_diagnostic: guardian records raw RUSAGE_CHILDREN before worker Popen and after worker wait plus adopted-descendant reaping; the delta is diagnostic and root may reconcile one max(0, delta-worker-charge) infrastructure amount without adding it to worker charge
infrastructure_accounting.root_settlement: root settles each recorded controller/guardian SELF snapshot once

receipt_projection.running: exact RUNNING only when immutable v6 top-level status is running and the verified owned_child identity exists
receipt_projection.terminal: uppercase normalization of the actual v6 terminal status completed or failed
receipt_projection.legacy_status: top-level v6 receipt.status is preserved unchanged

recovery.alive: reattach only when host, boot, pid, and start_ticks all match
recovery.exited: verify and terminate only the owned group, confirm every proof-only final reap, then remove one reservation and append one bounded unknown charge
recovery.unknown_cpu_interval: last trusted counter timestamp to confirmed group exit or hard deadline
recovery.unresolved_at_deadline: write durable failed_recovered_unknown upper-bound evidence at the hard cutoff while retaining reservation, lease, and slot; release is allowed only after a later confirmed owned-tree exit

no_parent_reservation.meaning: No reservation row was persisted; do not call this already_settled and do not append a charge

already_settled.meaning: A prior charge row already exists for this attempt; return the immutable row and never append a duplicate charge

source_initialization.activation_guard: exact resolved script path plus argv[1] == 'light-worker'
source_initialization.normal_controller_root: SCRIPT_PATH.parents[7] remains required for controller, dispatch, guardian, worker, recover, and status
source_initialization.purpose: avoid import-time parents[7] IndexError in the bwrap-mounted sealed light worker without widening any host source or ledger access

loader_mounts.source: resolved regular host directories mounted read-only at the exact conventional loader destinations
loader_mounts.purpose: allow the SHA-bound /usr/bin/python3.10 to resolve its dynamic loader inside bwrap

changes: Retain the opt-in approved_compiled_binary request branch; absent solver_branch preserves official v12 behavior.
Retain the exact completed BUILD004 report chain, source closure, M0, review, parent settlement, and /bin/linux target metadata guards.

Require the CUDA13 compatibility and accepted-step patch-helper results to have returncode == 0, elapsed_seconds, command, and truncated == false. Their timed_out field is optional because the real patch helper omits it; if present it must be false. Make and compile-probe retain required timed_out == false; missing required fields fail closed.
Keep the compiled executable deferred and excluded from input_files; do not open or payload-hash it before the shared reservation is admitted.

At owned_launch and after_owned_reap, hash once per phase through one O_NOFOLLOW regular-file FD; record FD fstat before/after plus lexical lstat before/after and require stable device/inode/bytes/mtime_ns/ctime_ns.
Exclude the compiled path from the generic deferred hash pass so the two stable-FD phase observations are the only compiled payload hash passes.
Preserve v12 ownership, limits, parent accounting, reaping, posthash, production G2, and official solver behavior outside the explicit branch.
